task_cases.name: Duplicate JSON fields are rejected recursively
Unknown enum and integer enum are rejected
Typed identity serialization preserves its exact GUID
Unicode scalar ranges preserve emoji, combining marks and Chinese
Wall time observations cannot advance action or combat clocks
Language target cannot silently rise or introduce speaking scores
Integer rewards use exact floor basis points
Read-only snapshot query does not write database or advance clock
